mapper.insert: insert into sys_dict_data(dict_id, dict_key, dict_data_label, dict_data_value, remark, dict_data_sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by) VALUES (#{dictId}, #{dictKey}, #{dictDataLabel}, #{dictDataValue}, #{remark}, #{dictDataSort}, now(), #{createBy},now(), #{updateBy})
mapper.update: update sys_dict_data set dict_key = #{dictKey}, dict_data_label = #{dictDataLabel}, dict_data_value = #{dictDataValue}, remark = #{remark}, dict_data_sort = #{dictDataSort}, is_default = #{isDefault}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where dict_data_id =#{dictDataId}
